text: Git branching is an important part of version control. A branch lets you work on new ideas without changing the main code. Developers often create feature branches to add new features or fix bugs safely. When the work is finished, they merge the branch back into the main project. Before merging, teams usually open a pull request so others can review the changes and give feedback. This workflow keeps the code organized and reduces mistakes. It also makes teamwork easier, because several people can work at the same time without affecting each other's work. Learning branches helps you become a more confident developer.
